1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?

# Conversation Analysis

---

## 1. "Dost" kaun hai aur third-person frame kyun?

**"Dost" Sameer khud hai.** Proof conversation ke andar hi hai:

- **Group (9:14 pm):** Sameer Dubai pool reel daal ke "expanding soon boys 😎" bol raha hai — image bana raha hai thriving businessman ki.
- **DM (11:52 pm, usi raat, sirf 2.5 ghante baad):** Sameer Faisal se **15-18 LPA** ki operations/GM job maang raha hai — kisi "dost" ke liye.

Yeh bracket koi "aadha Gurgaon" wala businessman nahi maangta. Yeh tab maangta hai jab kisi ka apna setup band ho raha ho ya already band ho chuka ho. Aur "isi mahine move karna chah raha hai" — yeh urgency tab aati hai jab khud ki runway khatam ho rahi hai.

**Third-person frame kyun?** Kyunki Sameer ki poori public identity isi image pe tiki hai — Dubai reels, "aadha Gurgaon," "expanding soon." Group mein log literally usse sponsor bol rahe hain. Agar seedha bole *"yaar mujhe job chahiye,"* toh woh image toot jaayegi jise usne mahino se banaya hai. "Dost" ek costume hai — isse Sameer ko bina self-image toda help maangne ka ek chhota sa darwaza milta hai. Lekin isi costume ne use baad mein phansa bhi liya.

**Secrecy request** — *"group mein iska zikr mat karna"* — iska matlab hai: koi group member ko pata nahi chalna chahiye ki yeh request aayi hai, kyunki agar kisi ne cross-reference kiya toh *"kaunsa dost?"* ka sawaal aayega aur Sameer ka cover ud jaayega.
